freeze_stage: before any benchmark execution; no tuning planned
normalization: NFC → lower with C.UTF-8 → unaccent → collapse whitespace → trim; original retained, punctuation/unit symbols not explicitly removed
a0: Original E06 key equality OR lower(btrim(name)) equality OR lower(btrim(alias)) equality; rank key 0, name 1, alias 2; numeric source ID tie-break. Legacy key = collection.field and name = field, no inferred alias.
a1: Same exact hits first; then normalized key/name/alias; then simple full-text AND query on names/aliases/description; then trigram candidate threshold 0.30. Within non-exact bucket: weighted full-text rank desc, greatest name/alias similarity or 0.5*word_similarity(query,document) desc, numeric sort ID asc.
filters: status active + explicit allowlisted metadata lab scope; original E06 type/anchor unknown so no type/anchor hard-filter; whole corpora eligible
index_policy: no search index; prepared normalized material only for A1 lab measurement; no production deployment
timing: one persistent psql session per cell; first pass separately then five warm repetitions, no OS cache flush; EXPLAIN ANALYZE each query first pass; query timing from psql separate from ssh/harness wall
admission: No production admission implementation; real corpus admission NOT MEASURED. Separate TEST ONLY contract guard fixture tests generic comparisons, not system readiness.
